recommendation_reasons: only path needing no training -> immune to 87 unexpected shutdowns and dead RTC
2-6 GPU-hours vs ~57.6 h (C1) and ~250 h (C3) - two orders of magnitude cheaper
decomposes the undecomposed +0.00282 joint delta into a mechanism claim
supports a defensible harm-avoidance claim rather than superiority
authorization_distinction: executing frozen arms A0/A1/A8 is NOT adding a factor; authorisation is required because the contract declares execution NONE, not because anything would be added
excluded: any new factor added to Phase-28

population.conflict: Phase-22/29 used VAL808; contract states ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT - must be resolved and frozen before launch

held_constant.fusion_rule: outside ROI p_global; inside ROI p_refined; threshold 0.50

primary_endpoint: macro-domain equal-weight mean Dice delta, paired per case, bootstrap CI (n_boot 2000, seed 42) for A8-A0, A8-A1, A1-A0
secondary_endpoints: harm rate and mean harm per arm using the Phase-22 definition verbatim
expected_compute: 2-6 GPU-hours, restartable per arm, no long unattended window

claim_boundary.permitted: routing changed macro Dice by X and reduced harmed-case rate from Y to Z on the development population

prerequisites.item: four frozen components present with matching digests
authorization to execute a contract declared execution NONE
R1-R10 satisfied for an inference-only study
negative-control battery demonstrating the gate can fail
